# ✨ Simply OptiFabric

The lightweight and modern OptiFine alternative for Fabric. Enjoy better performance, modern compatibility, and an optimized Minecraft experience without compromising simplicity.

[![Available on CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Available%20on-CurseForge-F16436?style=for-the-badge\&logo=curseforge\&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/simply-optifabric)

Simply OptiFabric is a lightweight and carefully curated Fabric modpack designed to deliver an OptiFine-like experience using modern Fabric technologies.

Focused on simplicity, performance, compatibility, and visual enhancements, Simply OptiFabric provides a clean and reliable experience for players who want familiar OptiFine features while benefiting from the flexibility and future-proof design of the Fabric ecosystem.

---

## 🚀 Main Benefits

| Feature                   | Description                                                     |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ⚡ Better Performance      | Delivers smoother gameplay and improved responsiveness.         |
| 💾 Lower Resource Usage   | Optimizes memory usage and reduces unnecessary system load.     |
| 🌅 Modern Shader Support  | Enjoy shaders through the modern Fabric ecosystem.              |
| 🧱 Rendering Optimization | Improves rendering efficiency for blocks, entities, and chunks. |
| 👀 Smart Visibility       | Prevents rendering objects that cannot be seen by the player.   |
| 🌐 Multiplayer Ready      | Improves multiplayer responsiveness and server performance.     |
| 🛡️ Background Efficiency | Reduces resource usage while Minecraft is minimized.            |

## 💡 Philosophy

Simply OptiFabric follows a simple philosophy: provide the essential OptiFine experience on Fabric while keeping the modpack lightweight, clean, and easy to use.

Instead of relying on a single all-in-one modification, Simply OptiFabric combines modern Fabric technologies to create a fast, stable, and future-ready Minecraft experience.
